summary: Stopped-member reconciliation reads invocation receipts through the existing subject index and reuses unchanged runtime-end folds instead of reconstructing fleet receipt history repeatedly.

replay.detail: Receipt identities, ordering and exact-incarnation end evidence are unchanged.

schema.detail: Uses the existing subject-kind index; no new index, table, migration or storage-version change.

compatibility.detail: Periodic full stop passes still verify physical runtime state, producer closure, native bindings and transcript availability. A new receipt for the subject invalidates the end fold; unrelated subjects do not.

downtime.detail: Normal binary deployment only; no offline preparation is required.

recovery.detail: Memoized folds are process-local and rebuilt from durable receipts after restart.
